Protocol amendment, no algorithm change. Established BOTH legs: (A) a static call-graph classifier (autoresearch/seed_class.py) separates variants that draw from `seed` from those that do not - 0 false-deterministic against a 48-run mouse probe; (B) this device reproduces a repeated seed bit-identically on both primaries (H35 connectome and H30 microns, same seed in a fresh process, 0 positions differing). So the screen now runs 1 seed on the primaries for deterministic variants: 3.17 h -> 1.06 h. Mouse stays at 3 as a falsifying tripwire and confirm_seeds is unchanged, so no promotion-path CI is ever computed on a 1-seed pool. Made operative by seed_plan.py + `sweep.sh --auto-seeds`, pinned by tests/test_seed_plan.py. Corrected the prior analysis's circular claim that protocol_se was unchanged (it is comparator-only by construction; the honest widening at n=1 is +41.4%). Filed P03 after observing an overlapping cycle handoff.

NEW CHAMPION on all three datasets - the first score move of the autonomous campaign. Mechanism: a structural BLOCK move class. Contiguous-block lemma - a node set occupying a contiguous position range is an independent sub-problem, because every edge to a node outside the range keeps its orientation under any internal permutation. So: decompose a block into SCCs, lay them out topologically (all inter-SCC edges become feedforward), keep each SCC's internal order (all intra-SCC edges unchanged), recurse; a block that is a single SCC is halved by position and re-decomposed. Monotone non-decreasing BY CONSTRUCTION, pinned by 31 unit tests. Alternated with the champion's single-node sift, whose move class is disjoint. Confirm (5/5/20 seeds, all bit-identical): connectome 84.097174 (+0.1837 pp vs H35), microns 83.233847 (+0.0276 pp vs H30), mouse 92.917014 (+0.0152 pp). audit exit 0, all 30 runs re-scored exactly. Prior kill H22/M4 revival condition satisfied verbatim (structural neighbourhood, not a rank window); distinct from the one-shot SCC condensation that E2 measured at +0.00013 pp. Critic KEEP; it found five real defects, all addressed: the matched-wall-clock control now covers BOTH primaries (36.0x / 13.0x) and is promoted to experiments/proto_h36_control.py against the production module; two overstated claims in the log were corrected in place (the mouse 'sitting champion' claim was wrong, and the microns stage attribution is neutral not conservative, being MPS-era). Filed H42 (the sizing curve was still rising at 31 cycles when we shipped 12), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority test can only be passed by a large improvement - mis-specified), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap).

notes: P01 + P02 done 2026-08-09; H36 promoted 2026-08-10. THE CHAMPION IS NOW H36 ON ALL THREE DATASETS (connectome 84.0972, microns 83.2338, mouse 92.9170) - compare every new variant against that, not against H35/H30. H36 = H35's pipeline + a stage-4 structural BLOCK move class (src/mfas/refine/scc_recursive.py) alternated with the single-node sift; it is monotone non-decreasing by construction and adds 0 gradient steps. Remaining gap to the 84.6147 reference: 0.5175 pp. The three highest-value follow-ups are already filed and cheap: H42 (the stage-4 sizing curve was still RISING at 31 cycles and we ship 12 - likely free score), P04 (the mouse non-inferiority gate is mis-specified and cannot be passed except by a large improvement; it has now been waved through twice), P05 (stage 4 has no wall-clock guard and microns sits at 3314 s of a 3600 s cap). Three things a resuming session must know. (1) SEED POLICY (P02): the screen's seed count is per variant, not a constant - run `python autoresearch/seed_plan.py --variant <id> --role implement` and launch with `bash autoresearch/sweep.sh --exp <id> --role implement --auto-seeds`. Deterministic variants (H02/H16/H19/H30/H35 today) screen at 1 seed on connectome and microns; everything else at 3; mouse always 3, and if its 3 runs disagree for a deterministic-classified variant the primary numbers are VOID. confirm_seeds is unchanged. Rule: PROTOCOL.md § Phase-7.4; config: campaign.yaml seed_policy. (2) These pipelines take a seed but never draw from it, so sigma = 0 and a Welch CI built on those seeds is degenerate (SE = 0). A verdict needs delta > screen_delta_pp AND the floored PROTOCOL CI; audit.py emits significance.<ds>.degenerate when this applies. (3) microns costs ~3230 s/run here (706 s on MPS); max_cycle_wall_clock_h stays 10 because an rng-classified variant still needs ~8.5 h to confirm. IF THIS CHECKOUT IS MOVED AGAIN: set hardware_rebaseline_done=false, set seed_policy.device_determinism_verified.* to false and restore 3 seeds there, update `machine` and environment.device_tag, and re-run P01 - sota.json is machine-specific (see autoresearch/PORTING.md, incl. § 6b).
